bin.goalEn: Walk to the silver trash bin

edit.alignment: Capture timestamps, checked against walking, turning and stopping.

bin.provenanceZh: 节点说明依据录像与运行记录复盘。
bin.provenanceEn: Decision notes reconstructed from the recording and run log.

nodes.label: 任务目标
nodes.reasonEn: Walk to the silver trash bin

nodes.label: 接近立柱前的观察点
nodes.reason: 当前视野尚未出现银色垃圾桶。前方白色立柱上有绿色安全出口标志，中间过道通畅。先接近立柱前的空地，检查两侧被遮挡的区域。
nodes.reasonEn: The silver trash bin is not visible yet. An open aisle leads to a white column with a green exit sign. Move closer to inspect the areas hidden beside it.
nodes.instruction: Go straight to the white pillar with the green exit sign.

nodes.label: 向左观察走廊
nodes.reason: 已到达立柱前，正前方主要是立柱和玻璃窗，仍未看到目标。向左转动观察，展开沿窗走廊的视野。
nodes.reasonEn: The robot has reached the column, but the target is still out of view. Turn left to inspect the corridor along the windows.

nodes.label: 接近银色桶状物体
nodes.reason: 左转后，走廊右侧白墙与玻璃窗之间出现灰银色桶状物体，与目标外观相符。前方瓷砖通道可通行，沿走廊接近并核实。
nodes.reasonEn: A grey-silver bin-shaped object is visible between the white wall and the windows on the right. Follow the clear tiled corridor to inspect it up close.
nodes.instruction: Go straight down the corridor towards the grey cylindrical bin near the glass wall on the right.

nodes.label: 到达垃圾桶旁
nodes.reason: 停车后的画面中，银色金属垃圾桶清楚可见，位于机器人右前方的白墙旁。实拍也显示机器人停在桶旁，已到达目标位置。
nodes.reasonEn: The stopped camera view clearly shows the silver metal trash bin beside the white wall at the front-right. The external view also shows the robot stopped beside it.
